discovery_method: GitHub public repository search followed by exact public repository metadata verification; fork flag checked per repository
limitations: This is a point-in-time search snapshot, not proof that GitHub search returned every public repository on each account.
Account-level totals previously stated by the owner do not exactly match the public search results; unresolved differences are not treated as public projects.
Only selected README files have received purpose-level review. Metadata-reviewed entries require deeper content and security review.
A declared or detected SPDX license is not a file-level provenance or redistribution approval.
No source archives, code, binaries, dependencies, credentials, or private materials are included.
